description: Placeholder test media files for verifying image, video, and icon support in the SugarCube Story Harness. These files do NOT need to match any scene content. All images and the first video are from Wikimedia Commons under their respective licenses. Icons are original SVGs created for testing. Videos 3-5 are copies of video_1 due to Wikimedia rate limiting during download.
license_note: See individual file entries for specific licenses. Wikimedia Commons files retain their original licenses (Public Domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA). Icon SVGs are CC0 (original works created for testing).
